sn21.6:1.2: Atha kho āyasmā Lakuṇṭakabhaddiyo yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || || 3
sn21.6:1.3: Addasā kho Bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Lakuṇṭakabhaddiyam dūrato va āgacchantaṃ || ||
sn21.6:1.5: Passatha no tumhe bhikkhave etam bhikkhum āgacchantaṃ dubbaṇṇaṃ duddassikam okoṭimakam bhikkhūnam paribhūtarūpanti || ||
sn21.6:1.7: Eso kho bhikkhave bhikkhu mahiddhiko mahānubhāvo || na ca sā samāpatti sulabharūpā yā tena bhikkhunā asamāpannapubbā ||
sn21.6:1.8: Yassa catthāya kulaputtā sammad eva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti || tad anuttaram brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayam abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatīti || || 6
